abilities.name: Flames Weave Life
_curatorNotes: Base normals are 4-hit physical claymore strikes (Ring mode, the default armament state). N3 lands 3 hits (hitmarks 28/33/39) and N2 lands 2 (14/26); per recipe, swap reflects the last hitmark only.
Inside Nightsoul Blessing (= Burst's Crucible of Death and Life window), N input routes to Flamestrider Strikes — separate normal ability gated on state: "nightsoulBlessing" with 5-hit Pyro chain.

plungeFrames sourced from gcsim highPlungeFrames (high plunge from CA-leap or Xianyun launch). Low plunge variant exists (swap=62, N=51, C=52, E=37, Q=51, D=37) but the schema's single plungeFrames captures the dominant rotation use (high plunge).

Hold-E (Flamestrider mode) entry into bike state is NOT modelled as a Nightsoul opener — schema's AbilityVariant cannot override opensState (only base SkillAbility can). The simplification: only Burst opens NS Blessing in our timeline. Hold-E in the planner will fire its frames but won't transition normals to Flamestrider chain. See burst caveat.

abilities.name: Flamestrider Strikes
_curatorNotes: 5-hit Pyro chain (vs 4-hit physical base) gated by state: "nightsoulBlessing". Hitmarks 19/24/31/13/37. Each strike consumes ~1 NS point (gcsim reduceNightsoulPoints on each NA hit).

infusion: "pyro" — gcsim ai.Element=Pyro + IgnoreInfusion=true on bike normals. Schema's infusion field renders the element correctly even though IgnoreInfusion has no schema-level analog (Mavuika's infusion can't be overridden by other elements).

chargeFrames omitted: bike charge attack (Flamestrider CA) is a continuous-spin attack with dynamic timing (50f minimum, 375f maximum, custom hit calculation per bikeChargeAttackSpinFrames=45f). The schema's static FrameMap can't represent this; gcsim handles it with custom logic in BikeCharge. ↻ 2026-08-18: this note used to end "The C key falls back to swap", which was wrong twice over. (1) There is no per-ability map to fall back WITHIN — with `chargeFrames` absent, `resolveChargeCastTime` substitutes the corpus-median `GENERIC_CHARGE_FRAMES` wholesale (src/lib/sim/resolve.ts:98; the map is anim 57 / N 51 / E 46 / Q 49 / D 25 / J 24 / swap 45, src/lib/data/genericProfile.ts:41). (2) FrameMap fallback is `anim`, NEVER `swap` — `frameAt` (src/lib/utils/frames.ts:66) is the one resolver, and the old `fm[key] ?? fm.swap` idiom it replaced understated a charged attack after a normal by a median 22 frames (L4b). Conclusion unchanged: a C during Flamestrider is timed as a generic charged attack, not as the bike spin.

plungeFrames sourced from gcsim highBikePlungeFrames. Bike plunge fires Flamestrider Plunge (skillPlunge mult, Pyro). Low-bike plunge variant (swap=75, N=60, C=60) not authored — high plunge is the canonical case via CA-leap.
Bike CA + bike plunge inherit C2 FlatDmg buffs (chargeFlatDmg/plungeFlatDmg via burstFlatDmg shared-stat in schema's terminology). C2 buffs authored on the constellation entry.

abilities.name: The Named Moment

summons.label: Rings of Searing Radiance
_curatorNotes: `terminatesOn: 'burst'` (summon-ends-on-cast round, 2026-09-19): gcsim's `Burst()` calls `enterBike()` and `skillRingTask` returns the moment the armament is not the ring, so the Ring is gone the instant Q is pressed. Measured before: `Mavuika E Q` applied Pyro at 4 / 8 / 12s from an entity the game deleted at 0.3s.

abilities.caveat: C1 lengthens the Hold window to ~13s, not shown, and a second press is read as a new Tap.
_curatorNotes: Hold-E migrated to a true variant-driven bike-NS opener (2026-05-08): variant overrides behavior → "stance", opensState → "nightsoulBlessing", terminatesOnSwap → true, duration → 9. Now possible since the parser is variant-aware for stance fields. The Tap form remains instant (no NS — ring-mode NS rendering would need full P1 multi-state to distinguish ring from bike inside NS).
Tap behavior: "instant" — gcsim skillFrames AnimationLength 28, ActionSwap 24. Hold uses skillFramesHold (AnimationLength 43, ActionSwap 34).
cooldown: 15 + cooldownStartDelay: 18 — gcsim SetCDWithDelay(skill, 15*60, 18) for both Tap and Hold; recast is skillRecastCD=60f and gated separately.

summon tag + the Ring (↻ 2026-09-15, essential-characters T0): the Tap exits bike → ring and gcsim exitBike starts skillRingTask, a 2*60 re-queue firing 'Rings of Searing Radiance' — Pyro, Durability 25, ICDTagNone, skillRing 230.4% ATK at TL10 — while armamentState == ring and Nightsoul Blessing holds. Authored as a real summon (interval 2, firstTickDelay 2, icdGate none). Its six ticks had been smuggled into this skill's application[] at 120…720f, where the CAST's shared ICD counter ate three of them and no bar or marker explained the Pyro. Lifetime is DERIVED from gcsim, not stated by the kit: the Tap enters Nightsoul at MaxPoints (80), nightsoulPointReduceTask drains 0.5 per 6f (5/s) in ring form and each ring tick spends 3 more, so the pool empties at ~12.4s after the sixth tick (12.0s) — duration 12.4. C1 raises MaxPoints to 120 (cons.go), which by the same arithmetic empties at ~18.6s after nine ticks: the +6.2 durationModifier. ⚠️ The Burst calls enterBike and skillRingTask returns once armamentState != ring, so in game Q ENDS the Ring; `terminatesOn` is swap|recast only (essential-characters §1.M), so the bar runs on — named in the caveat. The Hold variant carries `summons: []` because a variant's summons REPLACE the base's and Hold enters bike, not ring.

Recast (skillRecast) toggles armament state inside NS without consuming the 15s skill CD: 1s recast CD instead. Authoring recast as a 3rd skill entry would require either a state condition or a dedicated input token; both have downsides (resolveActiveAbility doesn't filter by token; state distinction would require a new bike state). Skipped — flagged in caveat.
Hold variant frames default keys (N/C/E/Q at 43 = AnimationLength) encoded for accuracy; D/J at 42 are gcsim-explicit overrides.

skillBikeRefreshFrames (E pressed inside bike+NS via Sac proc or burst CD reset): swap=24, N=27, C=27, E=39 (default), Q=27, D=25, J=27. Not modelled — treats this rare path as the same Tap variant. Acceptable approximation.

skillRecastFramesToBike (recast Ring → Bike): swap=24, N=13, C=13, E=13, Q=13, D=12, J=13. skillRecastFramesToRing (recast Bike → Ring): swap=24, N=27, C=28, E=28, Q=28, D=37. Both not authored — see caveat.
[A7] The shown 9s Hold window equals the C0 Nightsoul drain rate (~9 pts/sec at 80 max points); C1 raises max Nightsoul to 120 (~13s effective).
[A7] Skill recast to toggle Ring/Flamestrider mode is unauthored — there is no apexDrive-like state to gate the recast frames, so a re-press falls back to the standard Tap variant.
↻ 2026-09-15: caveat rewritten to lead with the Ring's post-Q ticks (the canonical E→Q opener shows them); the C1 Hold-window and recast halves are kept in shorter words.
abilities.description:
Calling upon her authority over "conflict," Mavuika summons the All-Fire Armaments passed down through the line of human Archons, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.
After using this, Mavuika's Nightsoul points are restored to max value, and she enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

All-Fire Armaments
Has different forms when Tapped or Held.

Tap
"Divine Name Unleashed": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Ring of Searing Radiance. The Ring follows the current active character and attacks nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.

Hold
"Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to opponents along her path.

While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

abilities.name: Hour of Burning Skies
_curatorNotes: behavior: "stance" + opensState: "nightsoulBlessing" + duration: 7 + terminatesOnSwap: true. The 7s reflects burstDuration (= Crucible of Death and Life window), during which gcsim nightsoulConsumptionMul returns 0 (NS drain is paused). After Crucible expires, NS drains the residual 10 points granted at burst hitmark; total bike+NS window is ~8s but the Crucible's clean 7s is the gameplay-relevant slice.
terminatesOnSwap: true — gcsim onExitField subscribes OnCharacterSwap and deletes burstKey + exits bike if active. Matches Mizuki/Xilonen-shape behavior.

Burst hits at burstHitmark=106f (Sunfell Slice). Frames map captures gcsim explicit overrides (swap/Attack/Charge/Skill/Burst/Dash/Jump all 116 = ActionSwap). Q → Q transition uses the full 141f animation length; encoded for accuracy.

Sunfell Slice FlatDmg = burstStacks × burstQBonus × ATK (gcsim burstBuffSunfell). Burst stacks = Fighting Spirit consumed (100–200 typically). Stacks-gated FlatDmg scaling is the deferred-stacks gap — not authored. Same for in-bike NA/CA buffs (burstBuffNA/CA) which fire only during Crucible.
Energy cost authored as 100 (= 50% of 200 Fighting Spirit threshold). C1 raises max FS to 250 with +25% gain efficiency, so C1's effective threshold scales similarly; not modelled.

Fighting Spirit gain: gcsim subscribes OnNightsoulConsume (any char's NS consumption → +consumed amount) and OnEnemyDamage (teammate normal attacks → +1.5 FS per hit, 0.1s ICD). Pure resource flow, not modelled per the constitution.
C2 +200 baseAtk during NS Blessing modelled on the C2 constellation entry. C2 in-bike FlatDmg additions (NA/CA/Q at 60%/90%/120% ATK respectively) also modelled there.

[A7] Caveat trimmed to the Fighting-Spirit-not-Energy divergence plus the ~1s-longer real window. Already in curator notes: energyCost 100 = 50% of the 200 Fighting Spirit threshold, C1's 250 cap (~60% threshold), and the 7s = Crucible / ~8s-total residual drain (frozen Nightsoul drain during Crucible, then the 10 points granted at burst hitmark drain at ~9 pts/sec).
[A7] To preserve: Mavuika has no in-game Energy bar (gcsim EnergyMax=0), and her skill's particle generation (5 Pyro, 0.5s ICD) does not fuel her own burst readiness — it feeds teammates' Energy.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The surviving half names the Q bar's own width: the burst stance draws 7s where the real bike/Nightsoul time is ~8s, so the swap point a reader takes off the bar is a second early. The dropped half names a pixel that does not exist on the surface this caveat reaches — the planner prints energy cost NOWHERE (it is drawn only on the Team Builder's detail card and Compare lane, which have no caveat channel), and the planner gates no burst on energy at all, so her Q behaves exactly like everyone else's and nothing in the timeline looks wrong. Category: visible-divergence.
abilities.description:
Let the people's inner voices reach the divine throne in the heavens.
Mavuika's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Energy, but instead, on "Fighting Spirit."

Fighting Spirit
When Mavuika has at least 50% Fighting Spirit, she can consume it all to unleash her Elemental Burst.
Mavuika can obtain Fighting Spirit via the following methods:
· When in combat, Nightsoul points consumed by nearby party members are converted to Fighting Spirit.
· When nearby party members' Normal Attacks hit opponents, Mavuika gains 1.5 Fighting Spirit. This can trigger once every 0.1s.

After using this, Mavuika gains 10 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Riding her Flamestrider high in the air, she uses a powerful Sunfell Slice against opponents on the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG and entering the "Crucible of Death and Life" state.

Crucible of Death and Life
During this time, Mavuika's various actions will no longer consume Nightsoul points, and her interruption resistance is increased. Also, the DMG dealt by Sunfell Slice and "Ancient Name Unbound"'s Normal and Charged Attacks is increased based on the amount of Fighting Spirit she has when using the Elemental Burst.
Crucible of Death and Life will be canceled when Mavuika leaves the field.

passives.name: Gift of Flaming Flowers
_curatorNotes: +30% ATK for 10s on team Nightsoul Burst event. Authored 2026-05-09 with the new onTeamNightsoulBurst trigger primitive (F2C). Renders from each nbBars event in the timeline regardless of Mavuika's field state (NB is a global team event in gcsim — event.OnNightsoulBurst).
passives.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mavuika's ATK increases by 30% for 10s.

passives.name: "Kiongozi"
passives.caveat: The shown +40% DMG bonus assumes full Fighting Spirit (200 consumed); it actually scales 0.2% per point spent up to that cap, so lower amounts are not modeled. C4 removes the 20s decay and adds +10%, also not modeled.
_curatorNotes: Per-Fighting-Spirit-point DMG bonus to active char (0.2% per FS consumed at burst, max 40% at 200 FS) decaying linearly over 20s post-burst.

Migrated from caveat-only to authored buff (2026-05-08) using the decaying BuffValue primitive: startValue 40 (max-FS case), endValue defaults to 0. duration: 20 matches both the in-game effect duration AND the decay duration (the decay is rendered over the buff's duration). Trigger: onCast burst, target: active.

Per-FS-point scaling NOT modelled in v1: the schema would need either a recursive value spec (decaying wrapping perStack) or perStack with a decayingTo field. Authoring at the max-FS peak is the same compromise applied to Yanfei A1 in the v1 perStack rollout.

C4 The Burning Sun enhances by removing the 20s decay (effectively converting decaying into a flat +40% allDmgBonus) and adding +10% allDmgBonus. Schema lacks a 'constellation removes decay' override — C4's effects entry remains unauthored, flagged in note. When C4 is unlocked, the visible bar would either need to swap from decaying to flat 40 (or 50 with the C4 +10%), or the planner would need to render the C4 case as a separate authored variant of this buff.

[A7] Per-FS-point peak scaling (0.2% per FS, cap 40% at 200 FS) is unauthored: needs the decaying BuffValue composed with perStack (perStack shipped 2026-05-08; decaying composition is a v2 follow-up). C4 removing the 20s decay and adding +10% needs a constellation-conditional override of the decaying envelope, not yet expressible.
passives.description: After using her Elemental Burst, Hour of Burning Skies, every point of Fighting Spirit present when it is used increases the DMG that the current active party member deals by 0.2%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 40%, and this effect lasts 20s, decaying over this duration until it reaches 0.

constellations.name: The Night-Lord's Explication
_curatorNotes: Three effects: (1) Max FS up to 120 (gcsim sets nightsoulState.MaxPoints=120 in c1Init when Cons>=1; this also expands the burst threshold to ~62 FS but more importantly extends the in-bike NS window post-Crucible). Pure resource flow, not modelled. (2) +25% FS gain efficiency (gcsim c1FightingSpiritEff returns 1.25). Pure resource flow. (3) +40% ATK for 10s after gaining FS — fires on every FS gain event (NA hit, NS consume); refreshes constantly during burst. Schema has no 'on FS gain' trigger; modelling as onCast burst would over-fire (refresh-on-NA semantics lost). Skipped — flag.
Removed prior placeholder atk% +40 buff (manual trigger, 8s) — duration mismatch (10s actual) and trigger semantics not capturable.
constellations.description:
Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.
Additionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.

constellations.name: The Ashen Price
_curatorNotes: Four passive-trigger buffs gated on (constellation 2) + (state nightsoulBlessing): (1) +200 Base ATK while in NS — gcsim c2Init AddStatMod with BaseATK=200; (2) Bike N FlatDmg +60% ATK; (3) Bike CA FlatDmg +90% ATK; (4) Sunfell Slice FlatDmg +120% ATK. The N/CA/Q buffs are technically scoped to bike state only (gcsim returns 0 if armamentState != bike), but in our model nightsoulBlessing only opens via burst (which forces bike), so the gate is equivalent in practice.
Removed prior placeholder damage effect (scaling 120 ATK with manual trigger) — the 120% is a burstFlatDmg buff value scaled on Sunfell, not a one-shot damage event.

Ring's -20% DEF debuff (gcsim internal/characters/mavuika/cons.go:63-82 c2Ring: DefMod -0.2, 0.5s modifier re-queued every 18f, only while isRingFollowing — below C6 that means armamentState == ring per cons.go:129-134): the shredStat:'def' primitive exists now, but our model has no Ring-form state (Tap E stays instant, no NS window) and nightsoulBlessing represents the Flamestrider/bike only — where this C2 slice does NOT apply below C6. Authoring it would draw the debuff exactly in the form where it is inactive; caveated instead. Capability sweep 2026-07-28. (The C6 slice, where the ring follows the bike, IS authored — see the C6 entry.)

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — A 20% DEF-shred debuff bar — the exact bar we DO draw for her at C6 — is missing after a Tap E at C2. Tap E is modelled as an instant with no Nightsoul window at all, so the reader gets no stance bar and no debuff row where the game gives both. The asymmetry is what makes it confusing: the same shred appears on the timeline at C6 and vanishes at C2, which reads as a bug rather than a form distinction. Category: expected-but-absent.
constellations.description:
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 200, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:

· Flamestrider: Mavuika's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and her Sunfell Slice from the Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies deal 60%, 90%, and 120% of her ATK as increased DMG respectively.

Without modelling the underlying A4 buff (per-FS-point DMG to active char), C4's standalone effects don't have a coherent target. Removed prior placeholder allDmgBonus +10 buff (manual, no duration) — would over-apply globally. Description-only.

constellations.name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
constellations.caveat: The Scorching Ring's 20% DEF cut is shown for the full Flamestrider window after the Burst or a held Skill; in game it ends early if she swaps out. Not modeled: the following ring's Pyro pulses every 3s.
_curatorNotes: Three effects: (1) Ring hit → Flamestrider trigger 200% ATK Pyro (0.5s ICD). Ring summon entity isn't modelled (no summons[] entry on the skill); the on-Ring-hit trigger has no schema primitive. Removed prior placeholder damage effect (200 ATK manual). (2) Bike → Ring follower summons every 3s for 500% ATK Pyro AoE. Tick-based summon emission is P3 (Summon.effects[]) gap. Removed prior placeholder damage effect (500 ATK manual). (3) Out-of-combat NS regeneration: pure resource flow, not modelled.
Both (1) and (2) become authorable when the Ring is added as a summon (P3). For now, damage stays description-only.

C6 Scorching Ring DEF shred authored (capability sweep 2026-07-28): gcsim internal/characters/mavuika/cons.go:129-134 — at Cons >= 6 isRingFollowing() returns true unconditionally, so the c2Ring DefMod -0.2 (cons.go:76-79, 0.5s modifier re-queued every 18f = continuous) applies while riding the Flamestrider. Two onCast resShred shredStat:'def' effects whose durations mirror our modeled Nightsoul windows (burst 7s, hE 9s) — gcsim has no fixed per-application duration, the shred rides the whole NS window. Deviation from the sweep proposal: the passive+state shape would derive but never render (resShred windows require onCast/onHit/afterDuration + duration), so the Durin-C6 onCast fallback is used; the state condition is dropped because the triggering casts are exactly the NS openers (constellation:6 alone gates it).

buffWindows does not apply the onCast input filter to resShred pools, so the skill-hosted window also renders on Tap E — acceptable: at C6 (which implies C2) the Ring form's own DEF shred applies after Tap E in game too (Tap E also enters NS Blessing there).

↻ CAVEAT TRIMMED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass): kept only the on-screen half. Full prior text: "The Scorching Ring's 20% DEF cut is shown for the full Flamestrider window after the Burst or a held Skill; in game it ends early if she swaps out. Not modeled: the Ring-form crash attacks and the following ring's 500% ATK Pyro pulses."
constellations.description:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill The Named Moment receive all-round improvements:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: When the Ring's attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, she will also summon a Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance to follow her, which will decrease nearby opponents' DEF by 20% and deal 500% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 Nightsoul points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
